cohort: The study included 172 pregnancies in Italian women with Cystic Fibrosis from the Italian Cystic Fibrosis Registry (ICFR) between 2016 and 2023.
finding: The study found an increasing number of women with CF are achieving successful pregnancies, with preterm birth rates higher in women with CFRD and lower in those receiving CFTR modulator therapy, and a high overall cesarean section rate.
mod_finding: The overall cesarean section rate was 54.9%, peaking at 81.2% in women with CF-related diabetes.
gest_age: Preterm birth was defined as <37 weeks gestation.
